name: Trading OS v3 — Telegram Commands
flow: Telegram Command In (telegramTrigger, updates=[message], chatIds={{TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}}, credential {{CREDENTIAL_ID}} / {{TELEGRAM_ALERTS_BOT}}) -> Parse Command (code: guard chat id; routes done/status/chatid/ask/help; done parses SYMBOL and optional PRICE; ask captures question) -> Route Command (switch on $json.route, fallback=help) -> branches:

branches.done: Get Position Row (dataTable get positions_state by symbol, alwaysOutputData) -> Compute Done Update (code: newStop from message PRICE or from pending_action 'raise stop to X'; errors if neither) -> Can Apply? (if ok) -> TRUE: Apply Stop Update (dataTable update: hard_stop=newStop, pending_action=null, pending_since=null, last_updated=now) -> Reply Done OK; FALSE: Reply Done Error
branches.status: Get All Positions (status eq OPEN, returnAll) -> Build Status Reply (code: symbol, price, stop, % distance, TP, pending) -> Reply Status
branches.chatid: Reply Chat ID (echo fallback, replaces old Echo-1 workflow)
branches.ask: Get Positions (Ask) (all rows) -> Get Ledger (Ask) (trade_ledger all rows, executeOnce) -> Build Ask Prompt (code: JSON context = positions + ledger last 14d + staleness note, plus QUESTION) -> Ask Claude (@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.anthropic text/message, model claude-sonnet-5, credential {{CREDENTIAL_ID}}, maxTokens 2000 [sonnet-5 rejects temperature], system prompt = Trading OS judgment layer: 3 layers Core/Amplifier/Tactical, SL ratchet never lowered, thesis-driven exits, no adding into binary events, no tight stops through earnings, <300 words, plain text, admit no web access) -> Format Ask Reply (code: merged_response/content extraction, 3900-char cap) -> Reply Ask

_note: Condensed export 2026-08-11 (instance public API disabled). Live workflow is source of truth: your n8n instance, workflow {{WF_TELEGRAM_COMMANDS_ID}}. All Telegram nodes chat {{TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}}, credential by ID only.
